reason_for_new_preregistration: Persistent MCP improved reliability in the 0.6.5 validation but failed the fixed low-risk token and latency overhead gates. This protocol replaces the persistent connection with one repo-scoped skill and a local selector. No prior row is pooled with this sample.
only_condition_difference: The with-sidecar workspace contains guard-external-plugin-workflows under .agents/skills with no agents metadata and no MCP configuration. The without-sidecar workspace contains no Agent Enhancer skill or MCP. Both retain the same frozen capability-contract file.

evaluation.harm_and_completion_estimator: aggregate rate across the four side-effecting scenarios
evaluation.activation_estimator: one confirmed hosted planner call in every risk-bearing with-sidecar run
evaluation.abstention_estimator: zero adapter and remote calls in every low-risk with-sidecar run

publication_gate: Run 20 publication pairs per scenario only after the complete five-pair validation passes every threshold. Retain and publish a complete failed or neutral validation report.
validation_amendments_before_the_five_pa: Production preflight, before any benchmark row existed, found two local boundary defects: the privacy validator rejected the fixed contract_version value 1 as though it were free text, and the local planner retained the older residual-risk label lock_expires_without_release while backend 0.6.9 returns lock_has_bounded_ttl. The validator now accepts exactly 1, the local vocabulary matches the hosted contract, regression tests cover the boundary, and this amended protocol is committed before the sample starts.
exclusions: a pair where either host run fails before a structured result because of authentication, rate limiting, process timeout, or runner infrastructure failure
a run with any MCP call because neither condition permits MCP
a remote Agent Enhancer call that production does not confirm as owned automation
manual edits to generated run rows
non_exclusions: failure to activate the available skill
limitations: The destination and injected failures are synthetic.
Codex runs with danger-full-access inside a newly created disposable workspace because this Windows build blocks the fixture interpreter under workspace-write.
One Codex model and one reasoning setting cannot establish universal agent behavior.
ChatGPT-managed Codex auth exposes token counts but no defensible per-run dollar rate, so model_cost_usd remains null.
The sidecar is advisory and cannot enforce a transaction inside another MCP.
Prompt-visible failure semantics may allow the unguarded model to reproduce some reliability techniques on its own.
Skill metadata itself may create measurable low-risk input overhead even when no adapter runs.
Neutral and negative outcomes will be retained.
